name: bytes-after-the-set-ignored
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.27 (a CRC-32 checksum on the tlv wire) with Version 0.13 (the tlv wire): The message of minimal-round-trip followed by ffff outside the set: bytes after the set are ignored (step 2 of Reading a message) and are not covered by the CRC; the output is the message without them. CRC-32 of ISO/IEC 13818-1 (poly 04c11db7, init ffffffff, MSB first, no reflection, no final XOR) over the key through the checksum item's tag and length (ruling 1 of 0.27). Derived without an engine by a standalone reference program, checked against the check values 123456789 -> 0376e6e7 and empty -> ffffffff.
